bio_en: Nado Grigorian came from the village of Raram Geaduk in Bulanikh and emigrated to Russia as a youth. At 21 he fought in the Armenian-Tatar clashes in the flying bands of Keri and Aramayis. At the start of the volunteer movement he joined Andranik's unit and distinguished himself in the first battles, his company always placed at the front. He died of his wounds in the Van hospital on 21 May 1916.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
